body:
## Pull request overview

This PR aligns `DetailSection`’s responsive grid breakpoint behavior with the expectations in the test suite by switching 2-column (and the 2-col portion of 3+ column) layouts from the `sm:` breakpoint to `md:`.

**Changes:**
- Updated `DetailSection` grid column breakpoint for 2-column and 3+ column layouts from `sm:grid-cols-2` to `md:grid-cols-2`.
- Updated a stale test comment to reference `md:grid-cols-2`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx | Switches responsive 2-column grid breakpoint from `sm:` to `md:` in the conditional className logic. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.test.tsx | Updates the test comment to match the `md:grid-cols-2` expectation. |
